import re

VERSION = re.compile(r"^Pygments version (?P<version>\S+?),?(?: (?P<copyright>.*))?$")
TITLE = re.compile(r"^(?P<kind>\w+):$")
RULE = re.compile(r"^~+$")
ITEM = re.compile(r"^\* (?P<aliases>[^:]+):\s*$")
FILES = re.compile(r"^(?P<text>.*?)\s*\(filenames (?P<filenames>[^)]*)\)\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    head, l_head, items, l_items, skip = {}, [], [], [], []
    kind, item = "", None
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = VERSION.match(ln)
        if m:
            head["version"] = m.group("version")
            head["copyright"] = m.group("copyright") or ""
            l_head.append(j)
            continue
        m = TITLE.match(ln)
        if m:
            kind = m.group("kind")
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        if RULE.match(ln):
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        m = ITEM.match(ln)
        if m:
            names = [a.strip() for a in m.group("aliases").split(",")]
            item = {"kind": kind, "name": names[0], "aliases": ",".join(names),
                    "description": "", "filenames": ""}
            items.append(item)
            l_items.append(j)
            continue
        if item is not None and ln.startswith(" "):
            text = ln.strip()
            m = FILES.match(text)
            if m:
                text = m.group("text")
                item["filenames"] = m.group("filenames")
            item["description"] = (item["description"] + " " + text).strip()
            l_items.append(j)
    blocks = [{"name": "pygments", "kind": "kv", "lines": l_head, "records": [head]},
              {"name": "formatters", "kind": "table", "lines": l_items, "records": items}]
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": skip}
